turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with the part that matters: who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did nobody call me before he saw it on his phone in the middle of class?
I'm waiting, Hale. "Mm-hm" isn't an answer.
That's twice now. Either you tell me who entered that zero, or I walk down the hall to the principal's office and ask there.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
"Stopped listening." I'm writing that down, Hale. Now tell me what you have besides a software score, or this goes to the principal today.
